# Continual-ARC task note: task-2009aa15 — quadrant rotations

Verified solved (2026-10-21): Given an n×n input, output a 2n×2n grid of four copies of the input under fixed rotations, arranged as a 2×2 block:
- top-left: original input, unchanged
- top-right: input rotated 90° clockwise
- bottom-left: input rotated 90° counterclockwise
- bottom-right: input rotated 180°

For input A with zero-based indices and output B, each n×n quadrant is:
- B[0:n, 0:n] = A
- B[0:n, n:2n] = rotate_cw(A)
- B[n:2n, 0:n] = rotate_ccw(A)
- B[n:2n, n:2n] = rotate_180(A)
Each output has size 2n×2n. Rotation formulas: CW output[r][c]=A[n-1-c][r]; CCW output[r][c]=A[c][n-1-r]; 180 output[r][c]=A[n-1-r][n-1-c].

Evidence demo 2: input [[4,6],[1,8]] yielded [[4,6,1,4],[1,8,8,6],[6,8,8,1],[4,1,6,4]], exactly the four quadrant arrangement above. Demo 1 (12×12) likewise had the original in TL and rotated copies in the other three quadrants.
